title: Captured Russian and Chinese weapons shown underground at Crane
summary: Randy Anderson tells of Captured Russian and Chinese weapons shown underground at Crane, about 2014 at Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, Indiana, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, Indiana

tellings.quote: they were telling us about the uh some Russian and Chinese weapon systems that were captured

plain: A man named Randy Anderson, who says he saw strange technology at a military base, says that in 2014 at Crane, a Navy weapons centre in Indiana, he and others were taken underground and told about Russian and Chinese weapon systems that had been captured. He tells it as part of his account of what is kept hidden below that base.
